extName.description: Extension name, used by the toolbar, the Extensions page and the store title. Kept as the product name in every locale.

extDescription.message: A tiny X11-style CPU load graph for your toolbar. No accounts, no telemetry, six CRT themes, and nothing in the way.
extDescription.description: One-line store summary, prefilled from the manifest. Must stay identical to the summary block in STORE-LISTING.md, which scripts/check-listing.mjs compares against this file.

titleBar.description: Text in the popup's navy title bar, written the way the X11 xload window title is.

labelTheme.description: Label above the dropdown that picks one of the six colour themes.

labelRefresh.description: Label above the dropdown that picks the sampling interval.

labelGrid.description: Label beside the checkbox that shows or hides the graph's alignment grid.

labelScanlines.description: Label beside the checkbox that shows or hides the CRT scanline overlay.

themeClassic.description: Theme option: white paper background with a red trace, the default.

themePhosphor.description: Theme option: dark slate background with a cyan trace.

themeAmber.description: Theme option: near-black brown background with an amber trace.

themeMatrix.description: Theme option: black background with a bright green trace.

themeVapor.description: Theme option: purple background with a hot pink trace.

themeMono.description: Theme option: black background with a white trace.

rateUltrafast.description: Refresh-rate option: one sample every 0.1 seconds.

rateFast.description: Refresh-rate option: one sample every 0.5 seconds.

rateNormal.description: Refresh-rate option: one sample every second, the default.

rateRelaxed.description: Refresh-rate option: one sample every 2 seconds.

rateSlow.description: Refresh-rate option: one sample every 5 seconds.

decimalSeparator.description: Decimal separator for the status-bar numbers: a dot in English, a comma in French. One character, read by popup.js, so the number format follows whichever catalog Chrome picked.

loadPercent.description: Left status-bar readout: the newest CPU load sample as a percentage with two decimals.

memoryPercent.description: Centre status-bar readout: the share of installed RAM in use, as a whole percentage.

scaleMax.description: Right status-bar readout: the graph's current Y-axis maximum, which is rounded up to a multiple of ten.
